aliases.name: FAMAS F1
aliases.note: The 1978 service version, and the one this entry describes.

capacity.sourceNote: Proprietary 25-round magazine on the F1; the G2 takes STANAG 30-round magazines.

images.alt: A US Marine in camouflage firing a FAMAS rifle at a range, seen over the shooter’s shoulder: a black polymer bullpup with a long carrying handle running most of its length
images.caption: A US Marine on a familiarisation range during a bilateral exercise with the French. No freely licensed specimen photograph of the rifle exists on Wikimedia Commons.

credit.author: U.S. Marine Corps photo by Staff Sgt. Akeel Austin
credit.title: File:10th Marine Regiment French Bilateral Visit- FAMAS Familiarization Range (6919449).jpg

name: FAMAS
nativeName: Fusil d’Assaut de la Manufacture d’Armes de Saint-Étienne

massEmpty.sourceNote: F1. The G2 is published at 3.8 kg.

length.sourceNote: F1. The FAMAS Commando is 555 mm.

barrelLength.sourceNote: F1. The FAMAS Commando barrel is 285 mm.

cyclicRate.sourceNote: The article publishes 900–1,100 rounds/min. Recorded as the midpoint of that range; it is among the highest of any service rifle.

effectiveRange.sourceNote: F1; 450 m is published for the G2.

productionTotal.sourceNote: F1 production. The G2 is given as 10,000–15,000.
